Rank signed edges by deletion evidence

Source: R/sparse_regression_model.R
deletion_rank_weight.Rd

Converts signed coefficients and their deletion delta-BIC into the signed ordinal weights returned by [inferCSN()]. Edges are ranked by decreasing deletion evidence; evidence within `1e-12 * (1 + abs(maximum))` of a group's maximum shares one rank, and the sign of the coefficient is kept.

Usage

deletion_rank_weight(coefficient, deletion_delta_bic)

Arguments

coefficient

Signed coefficients.

deletion_delta_bic

Non-negative deletion delta-BIC, one per coefficient.

Value

Signed weights in (-1, 1); zero, non-finite or negative-evidence entries receive 0.

Examples

deletion_rank_weight(c(0.5, -1.2, 0.3, 0), c(4, 9, 4, 2))
#> [1]  0.25 -0.75  0.25  0.00
